---
name: New cartridge proposal
about: Propose a new plant/domain cartridge before authoring it
title: "[cartridge] "
labels: cartridge
---

**Plant / domain**
What system (e.g. fired heater, compressor, batch reactor) and why it is worth
adding.

**Hazards to cover**
The main hazards and their mechanisms.

**Consequence model**
How consequences would be verified deterministically (which physics / state
model). ADMIT requires a deterministic verifier, not a heuristic.

**Knowledge sources**
Literature, standards, or incident sources for the cause→effect entries (so
provenance and review status are clear).

**Authority / escalation angle**
Any cases where the physically obvious fix lies outside the agent's authority.

**Review plan**
Who can domain-review the cause→effect entries before they move past
`candidate`.
